A LITTLE CLARITY

Good questions.
Useful answers.

What should I include in a shipping enquiry?+

Share the item description, pickup and destination locations, package count, packed weight, dimensions and preferred delivery timing. The quote form helps you collect these details.

Where can I get an update on an existing shipment?+

Call or WhatsApp the team with your name, destination and shipment details. Someone from the team can help with your question.

Has my message been sent after completing the form?+

No. The form prepares a message and provides a WhatsApp link. You need to open WhatsApp, review the message and send it yourself.

What are your business hours?+

Verified opening hours have not been supplied. Please call before visiting an office.
